title: Casio Vintage Digital Unisex Metal Watch A159WA-N1DF
description: The Casio A159WA-N1DF is a reliable digital watch that seamlessly blends function and style. The watch boasts a stainless steel case and band that gives it a sleek and polished look. The large, easy-to-read display features the time, date, and stopwatch functions, making it perfect for keeping you on schedule. The LED light allows you to check the time even in low-light conditions. It’s water-resistant design makes it suitable for a variety of activities and it has a battery life of up to 7 years, so you don’t have to worry about constantly replacing it. The Casio A159WA-N1DF is a great option for those who want a dependable watch that looks good too.
features: 1/100-second stopwatch Measuring capacity: 59’59.99″ Measuring modes: Net time, split time, 1st-2nd place times
Regular time keeping: Hour, minute, second, pm, date, day
